verdict.rationale: Smooth documents proxy support: you pass your own proxy server details in task parameters to run tasks from a different IP. A `"self"` option tunnels traffic through your own IP. A community comment also quotes 'proxy rotation' and auto-CAPTCHA solvers from Smooth's marketing. Missing for 10: any documented stealth fingerprinting, managed residential or geo-targeted proxy pools (users must bring their own proxy), and independent evidence that the anti-bot measures work.
